posts.text: “Somebody, probably long ago retired,” Mark Attanasio said, “sat in the front row when I did my first interview. He said, ‘You won’t be so cheery when you lose for another 22 years!’” Well, 22 years later, the Brewers are in the World Series. www.mlb.com/news/brewers...
posts.jp: 「おそらくずっと前に引退した誰かが、私の最初のインタビューで最前列に座っていてね。『あと22年負け続けても、そんなに陽気でいられるかな!』と言われたよ」とマーク・アタナシオ。それから22年、ブルワーズがワールドシリーズに進出した。

posts.text: Plenty of Major Leaguers have baseball in their bloodlines, but few have the sport coursing through their veins like Brewers rookie shortstop Cooper Pratt. www.mlb.com/news/cooper-...

posts.text: No. 19 Guardians prospect Welbyn Francisca is 3-for-4 tonight and has multiple hits in five of his first six games in the Arizona Fall League. He's 16-for-26 (.615) and has struck out only once so far for Surprise. On an absolute heater in the desert.
